definitions.explanation: A personality trait of being reluctant to step forward or assert oneself. Describes someone who holds back in social situations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{引|ひ}っ{込|こ}み{思案|じあん}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧だ。
{引|ひ}っ{込|こ}み{思案|じあん}だった⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧になってきた。
examples.english: My daughter, who used to be withdrawn, has recently become more outgoing.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{込|こ}み{思案|じあん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{商売|しょうばい}→商売：03239_shoubai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧いかない。
examples.english: You can't succeed in business if you're too timid.

notes:
Literally "pulling-back thinking" — the idea of hesitating and overthinking rather than stepping forward.

USAGE:
Often used with な to modify nouns: {引|ひ}っ{込|こ}み{思案|じあん}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a timid person). Describes a mild, everyday form of shyness rather than clinical anxiety.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{内気|うちき}→内気：16836_uchiki⟧: introverted, shy (emphasizes quiet nature)
- ⟦{消極的|しょうきょくてき}→消極的：04779_shoukyokuteki⟧: passive, negative (broader, not just social)
- ⟦{人見知|ひとみし}り→人見知り：06622_hitomishiri⟧: shy around strangers (especially children)
- {恥|は}ずかし⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: someone who gets embarrassed easily
- ⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧: proactive, assertive (opposite quality)
